content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers Growing in Evansville
content_blocks.text:
Evansville's manufacturing and healthcare sectors are driving steady demand for certified project managers. Berry Global, headquartered locally, continues expanding operations and managing complex logistics and production initiatives across its Evansville footprint. Deaconess Health System and Ascension St. Vincent Evansville similarly rely on skilled project professionals to oversee facility upgrades, clinical program rollouts, and infrastructure improvements. Old National Bank's downtown headquarters development and the I-69 Ohio River Crossing project—a major regional infrastructure initiative connecting Evansville to Henderson, Kentucky—exemplify the kinds of cross-functional, multi-phase efforts that benefit from formal project management credentials. Employers across healthcare, manufacturing, and financial services increasingly favor candidates with formal credentials like CAPM or PMP for mid-to-senior positions, even when not explicitly required in a job posting. Completing Granite PM Academy's CAPM Certification & Boot Camp gives you the credential and framework to stand out in Evansville's competitive but steady regional market—and positions you to advance faster as local organizations invest in larger, more complex projects.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Evansville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and meet PMI's project management education requirement. No work experience is necessary—a key advantage for Evansville professionals entering or transitioning into project management roles.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, allowing you to master CAPM fundamentals without extended time away from your current role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, complete the credential application, and pay the examination fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy guides you through this process to ensure accurate submission and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice assessments and targeted review sessions. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the computer-based test at your chosen testing center or approved remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. PMI offers multiple pathways—including course attendance, volunteering, and self-directed learning—to meet maintenance requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
